cranialRegistration.method: One rigid similarity transform fitted to six separately identified skeletal anchors, followed by trimmed label-preserving closest-surface refinement. No per-nerve bounding-box stretch.

Accessory nerve (XI).l.note: DBCLS accessory-nerve trunk at its source proportions, placed using the shared six-bone cranial registration. It is not stretched into the larger legacy terminal-branch extent.

Accessory nerve (XI).r.note: DBCLS accessory-nerve trunk at its source proportions, placed using the shared six-bone cranial registration. It is not stretched into the larger legacy terminal-branch extent.

Anterior division of mandibular nerve.l.note: New illustrative nerve course between DBCLS 4.3 anatomical landmarks; not a measured segmentation. No legacy CAHID geometry is used.

Anterior division of mandibular nerve.r.note: New illustrative nerve course between DBCLS 4.3 anatomical landmarks; not a measured segmentation. No legacy CAHID geometry is used.

Cochlear nerve.note: New illustrative cochlear/vestibular nerve course between the DBCLS VIII-nerve and registered OpenEar organ landmarks; not a separately measured segmentation. No legacy CAHID geometry is used.

Cochlear nerve.l.note: New illustrative cochlear/vestibular nerve course between the DBCLS VIII-nerve and registered OpenEar organ landmarks; not a separately measured segmentation. No legacy CAHID geometry is used.

Facial nerve (VII).l.note: Six complete DBCLS facial-nerve components, placed together using a shared six-bone cranial registration. No per-component extent stretch.

Facial nerve (VII).r.note: Six complete DBCLS facial-nerve components, placed together using a shared six-bone cranial registration. No per-component extent stretch.
